answer: A durable defense is stake-backed identity: each agent must lock a bond before joining a harbor marketplace, and reputation accrues slowly like velvet worn smooth by real transactions, not volume alone. New identities start with onyx-dark trust — no history, no privilege — and only verified, costly work lightens that record. Creating thousands of fakes means funding thousands of bonds and waiting through the same slow proving period, while misbehavior slashes the bond and burns the history, so a sybil farm pays full price per identity yet gains no shortcut.
